move: card stack rises, front card peels off right, next steps forward
how: Four dark release cards share one position; a pose(depth) helper gives each y -22*depth, scale 1-0.06*depth and opacity fading to 0 past depth 2, so they read as a stack. They start 1000px below at rotateX 25 and rise back-to-front (expo.out, 1s, 0.1s offsets) while two masked header lines rise. Every 2.1s (from 1.0s) the front card peels away to x 260 / y -140 / rotate 10 / opacity 0 with power3.in over 0.55s, and every card behind it re-poses one step forward with back.out(1.4) over 0.8s; a pagination dot swaps class and pops from scale 1.8, and a counter label updates via call(). Each front card breathes y ±8 with sine.inOut while on. The aurora background scales 1.05→1.12 linearly the whole duration. The last card peels at D-0.75 and the header exits with expo.in; dots reset by class at D-0.02.
adapt: Change N and the card copy (kind pill, headline, body, placeholder UI rows), the accent dot colours per kind, and the background image; keep STEP 2.1s and the peel/step-forward pair (0.55s power3.in then 0.8s back.out(1.4)).
port: mount(el, shot) creates the header, N cards, dots and counter from shot data; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with START and STEP as fractions of D and the pose() helper unchanged. Replace the className tweens and call() counter updates with tweens on scoped elements; '.dots .dN' and '.num .n' must be el-scoped.
caveats: background scale 1.05→1.12 never returns, so the loop jumps on the bg
